title: Annual Purchase for Maintenance of Forward Looking Infrared Video Management System

onscreen_lines.desc: FLIR Platinum Support Service Agreement (SSA) — Annual Fee. Covers all firmware and software upgrades (major and minor releases), prioritized technical support, remote assistance, remote health audit, FLIR representative on-site evaluation, and Single Point of Contact for the current installed system size (total channels and integrations). Pricing shall be firm through the twelve (12) month term and shall not increase if additional cameras / integrations are added during the SSA period per Section II.D of the Technical Specifications.
onscreen_lines.block: 1.1 FLIR Platinum Support Service Agreement (SSA) — Annual Fee. Covers all firmware and software upgrades (major and minor releases), prioritized technical support, remote assistance, remote health audit, FLIR representative on-site evaluation, and Single Point of Contact for the current installed system size (total channels and integrations). Pricing shall be firm through the twelve (12) month term and shall not increase if additional cameras / integrations are added during the SSA period per Section II.D of the Technical Specifications. 12 Monthly LS No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Weekly On-Site Technician (per Section IV.C). Contractor shall provide one (1) FLIR Latitude Enterprise certified technician on-site one (1) day per week for eight (8) hours per day to perform full-system audit to verify live camera feeds, verify recording per FLIR settings, and perform server health checks on all FLIR servers. Quote as annual lump sum inclusive of all labor, travel, etc.
onscreen_lines.block: 1.2 Weekly On-Site Technician (per Section IV.C). Quote as annual lump sum inclusive of all labor, travel, etc. 1 Annual LS No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Quarterly Preventive Maintenance Inspections & Written Reports (per Section IV.E). Four (4) PM inspections per year covering all equipment, software, and labor hours, with written reports delivered the first week of January, April, July, and October. Quote as annual lump sum for all four inspections and reports combined.

onscreen_lines.desc: Service Call Labor — Regular Business Hours. Fully-loaded hourly rate for on-site or remote service calls performed Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m., beyond the weekly scheduled technician hours in Line 1.2. Rate shall include all labor, travel, and trip fees. Billed in 1/4-hour increments (per Section XIII.J).

onscreen_lines.desc: Service Call Labor — Holidays. Fully-loaded hourly rate for on-site or remote service calls performed on any of the thirteen (13) Tarrant County recognized holidays (per Section VII.C). Same "fully-loaded" requirement as Line 2.1.
